concept_clearance.rule: A concept is kept only if rowih.api.lookup, over the English words of its description and their near forms, finds no entry of lexicon 1.0 whose definition states it; every entry definition was also scanned for two or more of those words, and the dialects' terms for any of them (PLAN.md § 4). Run on 2026-10-26 over the head 0201404.

specification/lexicon.md, § Word formation to § Compounds, and § Coining a word by definition
prompt.departure from the plan: The plan (§ 4) gives each agent the skill and the grammar summary. The agents also receive the skill's two other references, the notation and the lexicon listing, and the specification's rules of word formation and of definition. An agent with the skill installed can read its references, and these agents have no tool that reads files; without the listing an agent cannot know which roots exist, and without the rules of formation it cannot take the route of compounds and derivations that § 2 names. Recorded 2026-10-26, before any run.

game_rules_found_in_building: A definition gives a word its meaning in later messages of an exchange only, and the plan requires each message to pass rowih validate on its own; a word defined in one message and used in the same message, or in a later one, draws d.lexer.unknown-word (checked 2026-10-26 with rowih.api.write and parse). The definition route can therefore appear in the game only as a message whose definition itself refers to the concept, and the agents are told so.

decoding.model_rule: Each provider's model is taken at run time from its own model listing: the newest generally available model of the provider's flagship line that supports function calling, excluding previews, experimental, mini, nano, lite and flash models. The identifier chosen and the listing it came from are written to transcripts/decoding/models.json.
